rows.component_basis: liquid InO1.5 formula-unit mole fraction; runtime expands In2O3 into two MO1.5 formula units, matching Bischof's Table 8 x basis
rows.parent_standard_state: pure liquid In2O3 on the Bischof KEMS parent standard; use the opt-in KEMS condensate table
rows.source_citation: Bischof, Sossi, Sergeev, Müller & Schmidt (2023), Geochimica et Cosmochimica Acta 360, 1–15, doi:10.1016/j.gca.2023.08.027
rows.source_locator: Section 4.4.4, p. 9; gamma(InO1.5)=0.017(12) at 1674 K; Table 8 source-x anchor
limitations: The gamma anchor is for the An-Di eutectic at Delta IW +1.5 to +2.5.

Table 8 reports x(InO1.5)=6.9e-5 for the 0.0065-0.05 ppm 1_low polytherm surface range; this LA-ICP-MS-derived component mole fraction is distinct from the analytical-ppm column. Runtime x_source is calculated from caller composition on the declared formula-unit MO1.5 basis.
No solid-to-liquid fusion term is applied because the measured component gamma is already liquid-standard.
